title: Oracle Cloud HCM Cohort | YECC
description: Explore the October 2026 YECC Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management cohort, including modules, delivery approach, fees, schedule, and enrolment details.
heading: Build your Oracle Cloud HCM| consulting foundation.
lead: Build practical knowledge across HR processes, Oracle Cloud HCM modules, hands-on system practice, and functional consulting foundations.

details.heading: A practical route| into Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management consulting.
details.lead: Follow a structured learning plan with self-paced preparation, assessed practice, expert-led sessions, Oracle demo-system access, and interview preparation.
facts: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM, three days a week

curriculum.heading: Build working knowledge| across 9 modules.
curriculum.lead: The curriculum starts with ERP foundations, then moves into the functional modules used across the Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management pathway.
curriculum.includedLead: Detailed self-paced videos cover selected topics in the listed modules, supported by practical checks and trainer guidance.
included: Self-paced learning
Detailed portal videos support the topics covered in the program.
Quizzes and assignments
MCQ tests and one or more hands-on practice assignments reinforce each topic.
Oracle demo access
Use an Oracle Cloud ERP demo system for hands-on practice during the training period.
Interview preparation
Get support preparing for Oracle Cloud Functional Consultant interviews.

delivery.heading: Learn on a weekly rhythm| that keeps practice moving.
delivery.lead: Each cycle moves from preparation to hands-on practice and trainer-led clarification.

steps.label: Prepare
steps.title: Complete the scheduled self-study
steps.text: Watch the required portal videos or complete the assigned self-study before each planned session date.

steps.label: Practise
steps.title: Test your understanding
steps.text: Complete an MCQ quiz and one or more portal assignments that involve hands-on system practice.

steps.label: Clarify
steps.title: Join expert-led live sessions
steps.text: After completing the weekly self-study, join live online sessions led by expert trainers.

supports.heading: Build the knowledge and practice| expected in functional consulting.
supports.lead: The program combines product understanding, system practice, interview preparation, and continued upskilling support.
items: Prepare for Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant roles
Build a deeper understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM products and consulting
Develop practical system understanding through hands-on training
Prepare for interviews at consulting companies
Continue upskilling with support after placement

important.heading: Know the commitment| before you enrol.
important.lead: Review the published fee structure, schedule, and expected study time for the October 2026 cohort.
items: Course fee
INR 40,000 including GST, payable in advance.
Placement-reference fee
INR 40,000 including GST, payable only if you are placed through a YECC reference and after the placement.
Live-session schedule
Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM, three days a week
Expected daily commitment
4 to 5 hours a day. The brochure notes that participants can complete the program alongside a day job.

closing: Get guidance on the Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management cohort from the YECC team.
